en.name: Squat
en.about: A standing lower-body exercise: you bend at the hips and knees to lower your body, then stand back up. It builds strength in the thighs and glutes.
steps: Stand with your feet slightly wider than hip-width apart, toes turned slightly out and arms at your sides.
Draw your shoulder blades down and back, brace your abdominals and keep your chest up.
Push your hips back and down, bending your hips and knees together, with your weight balanced over the middle of your feet.
Keep your back flat and your knees in line with your second toes as you lower.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor, or until your heels start to lift or your back starts to round.
Breathe out and push through your feet to straighten your hips and knees together, back to standing.

mistakes.says: Heels lift off the floor. Keep your whole foot down and lower only as far as your heels stay flat.
Knees fall inward. Keep each knee in line with your second toe.
Back rounds at the bottom. Keep your chest up and stop before your lower back starts to round.
Feet shift or turn during the set. Keep both feet planted in one place.
